description: This file defines the MaintenanceRepo class with methods for managing machines, thresholds, logs, alerts, and work orders in a manufacturing equipment monitoring system. It includes database interactions, data mapping functions, and error handling for missing tables.

classes.name: MaintenanceRepo
classes.description: Repository class providing database operations for maintenance-related data such as machines, thresholds, logs, alerts, and work orders.

methods.name: ensureMachine
methods.description: Ensures a machine exists in the database; creates a placeholder if missing.

methods.name: getThreshold
methods.description: Fetches the threshold value for a specific machine parameter.

methods.name: upsertThreshold
methods.description: Creates or updates a threshold for a machine parameter.

methods.name: insertLog
methods.description: Inserts a parameter log entry into the database.

methods.name: markMachineAtRisk
methods.description: Marks a machine's status as AT_RISK.

methods.name: listAlerts
methods.description: Retrieves a list of alerts, with schema bootstrap if table is missing.

methods.name: getAlertById
methods.description: Fetches an alert by its ID.

methods.name: insertWorkOrder
methods.description: Creates a work order linked to an alert.
